text:
alex: quick sanity check — ran a streaming+toolcall throughput pass on p2d and results look 2x worse than expected. can someone eyeball?

alex: run details: model=redwood-7b, mode=streaming+toolcall, batch=8, seq=1024, runs=30. warmed kv cache with 5 prefills.

alex: command used:
```
python infra/bench/run.py --model redwood-7b --mode streaming --toolcall --batch 8 --seq 1024 --runs 30 --device p2d
```

sam: do you have the raw latency distribution? avg token vs p95?

alex: avg token latency ~24ms/token, p95 token ~60ms. for non-streaming baseline I saw avg ~12ms/token, p95 ~28ms.

maria: hmm that is big. did the streaming path pick a different kernel / quantization fallback? any warnings in logs?

alex: no obvious warnings in runtime logs. attaching the small extract below:
```
[2026-03-16T13:02:01Z] batch=8 seq=1024 step=1 token_lat=23.8ms
[2026-03-16T13:02:01Z] toolcall start idx=0
[2026-03-16T13:02:01Z] toolcall done idx=0 dt=12ms
[2026-03-16T13:02:01Z] kv_cache hit rate=0.98
```

dan: I can profile the runtime tomorrow on p2d. can you pin the exact commit and the bench config? also is this only when toolcall is enabled?

alex: commit=9a2f4b1 (runtime: streaming refactor), bench config attached above. i ran a non-toolcall streaming run and saw avg ~14ms/token (so toolcall seems to add ~1.7x).

sam: interesting — toolcall adds overhead for sure. could be the sync point when flushing tool output to stream. check ms per toolcall flush and number of flushes per response.

maria: can you paste the number of toolcall events per request and the size of returned payloads? that changes serialization cost a lot.

alex: typical convo triggers 2 toolcalls, avg payload ~800 bytes. flushes ~2 per toolcall.

perf-bot: CI bench summary: <https://ci.internal/bench/17788|streaming-toolcall-2026-03-16> — shows median regressions on p2d for streaming-toolcall compared to baseline.

dan: thanks — i'll run nvprof and the tracing hook to capture kernel timings. can someone add the new run to the perf dashboard (regressions -> streaming-toolcall) so we can track?

maria: adding now. will create alert if avg token latency increases >20% from baseline. also filing a small perf-issue and linking the PR for the runtime refactor to correlate.

alex: PR is here: <https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4824|runtime PR #4824> (commit 9a2f4b1). please comment if you see an obvious regression.

sam: i'll try a tiny repro with instrumented flush metrics: measure bytes/time per flush and compare streaming vs non-streaming. should have numbers by EOD.

dan: i'll schedule a profiling run 2026-03-17 09:00 PST on p2d. ping me if you want me to run other variants (quantized, q4f32).

maria: thanks team. action items: dan -> nvprof + trace (09:00 PST), sam -> flush microbench (EOD), alex -> attach full logs and sample inputs, maria -> add regression alert + link perf dashboard.

alex: thanks all :thumbsup: we'll sync async here and follow up in tomorrow stand if needed.
